run_metadata.coverage_summary: Tier-1 government portals (AusTender/Defence, buy.nsw, Buying for Victoria, QTenders/supply.qld, Tenders WA, Tenders SA, Tenders Tasmania, NT QTOL, Tenders ACT) were queried via WebSearch across jurisdictions; an extended-mode sweep for November-2026 closing dates recovered a batch of current buyer-originated listings on the official state portals. Tier-2 (water corporations/GBEs, universities, health purchasing) and Tier-3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Brisbane City Council Ariba portal, EstimateOne construction) were scanned, and dedicated source-discovery searches were run for new/rebranded portals and council VendorPanel migrations. HARD NETWORK LIMIT (unchanged from the 2026-11-04 run): the session blocks outbound DNS to every external domain, so every WebFetch returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND' and NO tender detail page or document could be opened. All captured entries are therefore HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY from WebSearch result summaries; deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values, submission mechanics and contacts could not be obtained and are left null. Three buyer-originated opportunities were captured with multi-signal corroboration: Defence LAND 6504 EOI (strongly corroborated, closes 26 Nov 2026), HealthShare Victoria Monitoring Products HPVITS2027-021, and Goulburn Valley Water Shepparton WTP disinfection upgrades. Several further November-2026 items surfaced in a single extended search but could not be corroborated or opened, so they were deliberately left out (listed in gaps) rather than recorded with unverified detail. One genuinely NEW source was confirmed: Forbes Shire Council (NSW) migrating all quotes and tenders to VendorPanel in 2026. No opportunities, sources, dates, values or contacts were fabricated.
gaps: CRITICAL - NETWORK: The session network policy blocks outbound DNS to all external domains. Every WebFetch (tenders.gov.au, tenders.vic.gov.au, buy.nsw.gov.au, hpv.org.au and all others) returned 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND'. Consequently NO tender detail page or document could be opened or verified this run: all three captured entries are headline-level from WebSearch summaries only, and deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, exact values, submission mechanics and contacts could not be obtained. These domains must be allow-listed in the session network settings for a verified, detail-level run.

UNVERIFIED CLOSING DATES: The closing dates and tender IDs on the three captured entries come from WebSearch result summaries of the official portal pages, not from opening the primary notice (DNS-blocked). They need verification against the primary notice before being relied upon.

SURFACED-BUT-NOT-CAPTURED: An extended-mode search attributed several additional current (November 2026) listings to the official portals - buy.nsw (enterprise desk booking & space management system ~6 Nov; card design & printing ~12 Nov; Sydney Opera House vending machines ~17 Nov; Aerotropolis Bus Depot technical advisor ~19 Nov; Henry Lawson Drive pedestrian refuge ~24 Nov), Buying for Victoria (Box Hill Institute grounds maintenance ~26 Nov), Tenders ACT (JACS interpreting & translating services ~17 Nov; ACT Healthy Waterways catchment research ~12 Nov), and Queensland (Townsville sewage rising main D&C; QBuild/Transport and Main Roads works). Follow-up corroboration searches either returned only older/closed versions (Opera House vending #2025/CSS1 closed Jun 2025; Aerotropolis/Transport for NSW ZEB Tranche-2 advisor closed Feb 2025) or found nothing, and none could be opened (DNS-blocked). These were deliberately NOT recorded as confirmed tenders to avoid logging unverified or possibly conflated detail; they are candidates for an allow-listed/authenticated future run.

Tier-3 corporate (MANDATORY scan performed): SAP Ariba Discovery returned no publicly-visible open AU RFx via WebSearch; the posting board is registration-gated. Brisbane City Council's SAP Ariba supplier portal confirmed registration was paused 23 Oct - 1 Nov 2026, resuming 2 Nov 2026 (buyer-specific sourcing events remain registration-gated). Major-buyer portals (BHP/Rio Tinto/Woodside/Fortescue/Santos; Woolworths/Coles; CBA/Westpac/NAB/ANZ; Telstra/Optus; AGL/Origin; Qantas) surfaced no publicly-visible open RFx; invitation-only consultancy RFPs are out of scope. Relevant corporate portals are recorded in discovered_sources; no corporate tenders were fabricated.

Tier-2 universities / TAFEs / public research bodies (e.g. CSIRO): no current buyer-originated opportunity could be confirmed via WebSearch this run; university procurement is predominantly on each institution's own portal and largely not recovered through the search index. Deferred to a future run.

Tenders SA, NT QTOL and Tenders Tasmania: no current November-2026 buyer-originated opportunity could be confirmed via WebSearch (results were stale, South-African 'tenders.sa', or aggregator-only). Deferred.

tenders.title: LAND 6504 - Army Medium-Range Ground-Based Air and Missile Defence System (EOI)
tenders.buyer: Department of Defence - Capability Acquisition and Sustainment Group (CASG)
tenders.category: Defence - air and missile defence capability
tenders.description: Expression of Interest for the Australian Army's medium-range ground-based air and missile defence capability (project LAND 6504 / MRGBAD). Announced 13 October 2026 and issued via AusTender under ATM ID AIR/EOI/102637/1; responses close 26 November 2026. Reporting indicates the procurement will progress to an RFP/Competitive Evaluation Process in 2027 with a platform selection targeted for late 2027.
tenders.reasoning: Re-confirmed as still open via WebSearch on this run's Defence/AusTender query. Corroborated across multiple defence-sector news outlets (Breaking Defense, Janes, Defence Connect, Army Recognition) plus an aggregator listing showing posting date 13 Oct 2026 and deadline 26 Nov 2026. Buyer-originated via AusTender (ATM ID AIR/EOI/102637/1). Already tracked in the aggregate since 2026-11-01; recorded again to refresh last-seen because it remains open.
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY (entries_pending_detail). The AusTender notice could not be opened to verify deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, value, submission mechanics or documents - tenders.gov.au is DNS-blocked in this session. Sources differ on the exact stage label (EOI vs Competitive Evaluation Process); dates/ID taken from WebSearch summaries and sector news, not yet verified against the primary notice.

tenders.title: HPVITS2027-021 - Monitoring Products
tenders.category: Health - medical devices / patient monitoring products
tenders.description: HealthShare Victoria is seeking to establish supply arrangements for the provision of Monitoring Products (patient / physiological monitoring) to participating Victorian public health services, under tender reference HPVITS2027-021. Also surfaced on the Buying for Victoria portal with an indicated closing date of 26 November 2026.
tenders.submission_method: Lodge via HealthShare Victoria procurement portal (Jaggaer)
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via a Tier-1/Tier-2 health-procurement search attributing a HealthShare Victoria patient-monitoring tender (closing 26 Nov 2026) to the Buying for Victoria portal, and independently corroborated by a second search returning tender HPVITS2027-021 'Monitoring Products' issued by HealthShare Victoria on its own HPV procurement site (buyer-originated, not an aggregator).
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY (entries_pending_detail). The notice could not be opened to confirm the closing date/time, scope, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, value or contacts - hpv.org.au and tenders.vic.gov.au are DNS-blocked in this session. The 26 Nov 2026 closing date and 2:00 PM time come from a WebSearch summary and are UNVERIFIED against the primary notice; the tender ID HPVITS2027-021 is corroborated across two searches. Full opportunity detail on HPV typically requires free supplier registration.

tenders.title: Design and Construction of Disinfection Upgrades at Shepparton Water Treatment Plant (WTP)
tenders.category: Water infrastructure - design and construction (water treatment)
tenders.description: Goulburn Valley Water (a Victorian regional water corporation) is seeking a contractor for the design and construction of disinfection upgrades at the Shepparton Water Treatment Plant. Part of a broader GVW disinfection-upgrade program spanning several of its treatment plants (Yea/Kyabram, Seymour/Cobram/Murchison, Barmah). Listed as a current opportunity; an indicated closing date of 24 November 2026 was reported.
tenders.reasoning: Surfaced via a Tier-1 Victoria search attributing a Goulburn Valley Water Shepparton WTP disinfection-upgrade tender (closing 24 Nov 2026) to the Buying for Victoria portal, and corroborated by a second search returning the same GVW Shepparton disinfection-upgrade opportunity marked 'Current', consistent with GVW's known program of disinfection upgrades across its plants (buyer-originated GBE procurement).
tenders.notes: HEADLINE-LEVEL ONLY (entries_pending_detail). The notice could not be opened to confirm the tender ID, closing date/time, scope, deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, value, documents or contacts - tenders.vic.gov.au is DNS-blocked in this session. The 24 Nov 2026 closing date and 2:00 PM time come from a WebSearch summary and are UNVERIFIED against the primary notice; no buyer tender ID could be recovered.

discovered_sources.source_name: Forbes Shire Council (NSW) - Tenders & EOI via VendorPanel Marketplace
discovered_sources.how_discovered: Source-discovery search on council VendorPanel migrations. Forbes Shire Council's own tenders page states it is switching to VendorPanel to issue ALL quotes and tenders to registered Marketplace suppliers in 2026 (catering sourced exclusively via the panel from 1 January 2026). A VendorPanel-sourced Forbes 'Provision of Welding Services - Preferred Supplier Panel' opportunity (published 24 Apr 2026) was seen via an aggregator discovery signal; the buyer's own source is recorded here.
discovered_sources.notes: NEW source this run. Buyer-originated local-government procurement moving onto VendorPanel; Marketplace registration is free for suppliers. Governance contact per council page: 02 6850 2300 / forbes@forbes.nsw.gov.au.
